title: unified-rollouts: observability and safety guards for canary/AB/shadow auto-rollback
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: customers saw spurious canary rollbacks due to single-metric sensitivity and lack of end-to-end visibility. This change improves rollout stability by adding metric quorum checks, shadow/AB quality matching, and richer observability telemetry. Summary of changes: 1) rollout controller: introduce composite-metric evaluator that computes a weighted quorum across latency (p95), error-rate, and quality/regression metrics. 2) safety guards: quarantine stage for models that fail a metric quorum, automatic downgrade to shadow-only mode before full rollback, and an optional manual approval gate for high-risk models. 3) observability: new rollout-specific metrics (rollout_canary_failure_rate, rollout_shadow_quality_delta, rollout_latency_p95_delta) and tagging (model_id, cohort, rollout_id) to surface in Console dashboards and alerts. 4) e2e and unit tests: add integration tests that simulate staggered regressions across metrics and verify quarantine->shadow->rollback transitions and alerts fired. 5) Docs and release notes: update rollout docs with examples and recommended thresholds + migration notes. Checklist: - [x] Implementation in rollout controller - [x] Telemetry + dashboards wiring - [x] Unit+integration tests - [x] Docs update - [x] Manual QA on staging Testing and rollout plan: ran full CI and targeted canary in staging (region: us-west-2) against model-suite v23-beta for 24h; simulated degraded quality and latency deviations to validate flow. Rollout path: canary (5% traffic) -> quarantine (pause + shadow) if quorum fails -> shadow-only probing -> automatic rollback if sustained regression > configured window OR manual-approval for flagged models. Backwards compatibility: new evaluator is configurable and defaults to legacy single-metric behavior unless projects opt-in via rollout policy. Migration: small migration script included to add default metric-config to existing rollouts. Notes: kept changes feature-flagged and with conservative defaults to avoid any surprise behavior in existing deployments.

Maya Chen: Added config path rollout.compositeMetrics.weights and rollout.compositeMetrics.quorumThreshold. Kept defaults at latency:0.4,error:0.3,quality:0.3 and quorum=0.6 per offline experiments. Added comment in evaluator.go.

Maya Chen: Added event producer and a small adaptor; it's behind the feature flag and disabled by default.

release_notes: Added composite-metric quorum and quarantine stage for rollouts; new rollout telemetry metrics (rollout_canary_failure_rate, rollout_shadow_quality_delta, rollout_latency_p95_delta); conservative defaults and opt-in evaluator. See docs for migration steps and recommended threshold guidance.
notes: Feature gated behind rollout.compositeMetrics.enabled=false by default. Migration script included to add metric-config to existing rollouts; revert path documented.
